title: BigCommerce vs. Shopify: When Second Place Is a Very Tough Place to Be
content:
Six years ago, BigCommerce was the credible number two to Shopify in ecommerce software. Not a niche player. The only standalone, pure-play public alternative to Shopify that a public market investor could buy. It was more B2B but worryingly, wasn’t growing faster on a percentage basis from a smaller base.
